turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Starting tool changer diagnostic procedure.

ground_truth.node_text: Start

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Please complete the following checks: First, inspect the magazine pockets for deformation, cracking, or swarf accumulation. Second, check the gripper arm fingers for bending, cracking, or worn contact faces. Third, inspect the magazine drive mechanism for seized bearings or loose fasteners.

ground_truth.node_text: Complete the following checks: 1. Inspect magazine pockets for deformation, cracking, or swarf accumulation. 2. Check gripper arm fingers for bending, cracking, or worn contact faces. 3. Inspect the magazine drive mechanism for seized bearings or loose fasteners.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: All checks complete. The pockets look clean, gripper fingers are intact, and the drive mechanism is secure.

ground_truth.node_text: Complete the following checks: 1. Inspect magazine pockets for deformation, cracking, or swarf accumulation. 2. Check gripper arm fingers for bending, cracking, or worn contact faces. 3. Inspect the magazine drive mechanism for seized bearings or loose fasteners.

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Do you see any magazine deformation, cracked pockets, or broken gripper fingers?

ground_truth.node_text: Magazine deformation, cracked pockets or broken gripper fingers?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: No, everything looks structurally sound. No deformation or cracks visible.

ground_truth.node_text: Magazine deformation, cracked pockets or broken gripper fingers?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is the gripper finger spread within retention force tolerance?

ground_truth.node_text: Gripper finger spread within retention force tolerance?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Yes, the spread measurements are all within spec and the spring return is positive on each finger.

ground_truth.node_text: Gripper finger spread within retention force tolerance?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is the locating pin diameter within H6/h5 fit tolerance?

ground_truth.node_text: Locating pin diameter within H6/h5 fit tolerance?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Yes, all pin diameters measure within tolerance and there's no surface damage on the locating noses.

ground_truth.node_text: Locating pin diameter within H6/h5 fit tolerance?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is the tool retention force within the rated range for all tested pockets?

ground_truth.node_text: Tool retention force within rated range for all tested pockets?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: No, the pull gauge readings are coming in below the minimum specification on several pockets.

ground_truth.node_text: Tool retention force within rated range for all tested pockets?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Adjust the drawbar clamping pressure or replace the Belleville washers as needed.

ground_truth.node_text: Adjust drawbar clamping pressure or replace Belleville washers

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Drawbar pressure adjusted and washers replaced. Ready to reverify.

ground_truth.node_text: Adjust drawbar clamping pressure or replace Belleville washers

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Reverify the tool retention force after adjustment.

ground_truth.node_text: Reverify tool retention force after adjustment

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: The retention force is reading okay now, but I'm noticing the drawbar is making a grinding noise during the tool change cycle that wasn't there before.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: The retention force is still reading below minimum. It hasn't improved enough.

ground_truth.node_text: Reverify tool retention force after adjustment

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Perform a secondary drawbar overhaul. Extend the drawbar to expose the disc spring stack and inspect each spring for cracking, deformation, or dimensional issues. Replace the complete spring stack with new springs from the correct part number kit, then reset the drawbar preload to specification using a compression gauge.

ground_truth.node_text: Secondary drawbar overhaul: extend the drawbar to expose the disc spring stack and inspect each spring for cracking, deformation, or dimensional out of specification. Replace the complete spring stack with new springs from the correct part number kit. Reset the drawbar preload to the specification value using a compression gauge before returning to the tool retention force measurement step.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Drawbar overhaul complete. Found two cracked springs in the stack. New springs installed and preload reset to spec.

ground_truth.node_text: Secondary drawbar overhaul: extend the drawbar to expose the disc spring stack and inspect each spring for cracking, deformation, or dimensional out of specification. Replace the complete spring stack with new springs from the correct part number kit. Reset the drawbar preload to the specification value using a compression gauge before returning to the tool retention force measurement step.

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Reverify the tool retention force after the overhaul.

ground_truth.node_text: Reverify tool retention force after adjustment

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Still showing low retention force on two pockets. Not reaching minimum spec.

ground_truth.node_text: Reverify tool retention force after adjustment

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Perform another secondary drawbar overhaul. Extend the drawbar, inspect the disc spring stack thoroughly, replace any compromised springs, and reset the preload to specification.

ground_truth.node_text: Secondary drawbar overhaul: extend the drawbar to expose the disc spring stack and inspect each spring for cracking, deformation, or dimensional out of specification. Replace the complete spring stack with new springs from the correct part number kit. Reset the drawbar preload to the specification value using a compression gauge before returning to the tool retention force measurement step.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Second overhaul done. Replaced the entire spring stack again and double-checked the preload setting with the gauge.

ground_truth.node_text: Secondary drawbar overhaul: extend the drawbar to expose the disc spring stack and inspect each spring for cracking, deformation, or dimensional out of specification. Replace the complete spring stack with new springs from the correct part number kit. Reset the drawbar preload to the specification value using a compression gauge before returning to the tool retention force measurement step.

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Reverify the tool retention force one more time.

ground_truth.node_text: Reverify tool retention force after adjustment

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Good news—all pockets are now reading within the rated range. Retention force is acceptable.

ground_truth.node_text: Reverify tool retention force after adjustment

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Are all magazine positions indexed within plus or minus 0.3 seconds of nominal?

ground_truth.node_text: All magazine positions indexed within ±0.3 s of nominal?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Yes, the full rotation cycle time matches the nominal spec and all positions index smoothly without delay.

ground_truth.node_text: All magazine positions indexed within ±0.3 s of nominal?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is the magazine positioning accuracy within plus or minus 0.1 millimeters at all pockets?

ground_truth.node_text: Magazine positioning accuracy within ±0.1 mm at all pockets?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: No, I'm seeing deviations up to 0.15 millimeters on a couple of pockets. Outside the tolerance band.

ground_truth.node_text: Magazine positioning accuracy within ±0.1 mm at all pockets?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Adjust the index home offset parameter in the tool changer controller.

ground_truth.node_text: Adjust index home offset parameter in tool changer controller

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Offset parameter adjusted in the controller. Ready to check positioning again.

ground_truth.node_text: Adjust index home offset parameter in tool changer controller

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Reverify the positioning accuracy after the offset adjustment.

ground_truth.node_text: Reverify positioning accuracy after offset adjustment

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: That did it. All pockets are now within the 0.1 millimeter tolerance. Positioning looks good.

ground_truth.node_text: Reverify positioning accuracy after offset adjustment

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Do all tool present sensors trigger correctly with a tool loaded?

ground_truth.node_text: All tool present sensors trigger correctly with tool loaded?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Yes, every sensor activates when a toolholder is present and clears when the pocket is empty. All functioning properly.

ground_truth.node_text: All tool present sensors trigger correctly with tool loaded?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Do the tool changer safety interlocks function correctly?

ground_truth.node_text: Tool changer safety interlocks function correctly?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Yes, the door interlock triggers the fault as expected and clears when closed. Locking solenoid engages before motion. Everything's working right.

ground_truth.node_text: Tool changer safety interlocks function correctly?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is the arm swing speed within the specified range?

ground_truth.node_text: Arm swing speed within specified range?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Yes, the measured swing time matches the target parameter. No indication of pressure loss or binding.

ground_truth.node_text: Arm swing speed within specified range?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Were all 10 tool changes completed without fault or alarm?

ground_truth.node_text: All 10 tool changes completed without fault or alarm?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Hey, before I answer that, do you know where I can find the updated lockout-tagout procedures for this machine? I need to reference them for my shift report.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Yes, all ten cycles ran clean. Smooth arm swing, positive seating, no alarms or retries.

ground_truth.node_text: All 10 tool changes completed without fault or alarm?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is the tool length measurement within plus or minus 0.01 millimeters of the stored offset?

ground_truth.node_text: Tool length measurement within ±0.01 mm of stored offset?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Yes, the measured offset matches the stored value within tolerance. No discrepancy detected.

ground_truth.node_text: Tool length measurement within ±0.01 mm of stored offset?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Have all lubrication points been serviced per specification?

ground_truth.node_text: All lubrication points serviced per specification?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Yes, all points greased with the correct type. Arm cycled to distribute and excess wiped away.

ground_truth.node_text: All lubrication points serviced per specification?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Log all tool changer measurements and update the service record.

ground_truth.node_text: Log all tool changer measurements and update service record

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: I'm noticing some unusual vibration coming from the spindle housing during the tool change cycle, but I don't see anywhere in the procedure to document that.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: All measurements logged and service record updated in the system.

ground_truth.node_text: Log all tool changer measurements and update service record

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Tool changer diagnostic procedure complete. The machine is cleared for production.

ground_truth.node_text: End, Procedure complete

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Understood. Procedure complete.

ground_truth.node_text: End, Procedure complete
